title_en: Until Dawn 2 Reveals Release Date in New Trailer
summary_en: Until Dawn 2 will release on PS5 this January, as confirmed by a new trailer for the game.
body_en:
Until Dawn 2 will release on PS5 this January, as confirmed by a new trailer for the game.
During today's PlayStation State of Play, Firesprite showed off a new look at Until Dawn 2. The trailer teases the franchise's signature branching narrative with deadly choices that can radically change the fate of your characters. However, the biggest takeaway is that the game is coming out very soon, much sooner than some of us could have expected.
Until Dawn 2 will release on January 28, 2027 with pre-orders opening on September 10.
Today's announcement comes as part of the latest showcase from PlayStation. Catch up on everything announced during Sony's State of Play September 2026 broadcast right here.
